newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse suspends trading in Zwack.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse suspends trading in Zwack.

text.p: The Budapest bourse suspended trading in spirits maker Zwack Unicum shares on Friday, just a few minutes before the close of the session, for the rest of the day due to a fast intraday price rise, traders said.
"It was suspended because of a too rapid price increase," one trader told Reuters.
Zwack shares opened at 4,550 forints, below Thursday's close of 4,650, and soared 22.58 percent to a new record high of 5,700 forints.
The suspension in trading in Zwack shares came after the deal at 5,700 forints at 1212 GMT, three minutes before the end of spot share trading on the Budapest bourse.
